description: This file implements in-memory hash tables with operations such as insert, delete, replace, find, and get-random-element. It handles resizing, collision chaining, and provides core hash table functionalities.

methods.name: dictCreate
methods.description: Creates a new hash table with specified type and private data.

methods.name: dictExpand
methods.description: Expands or creates the hash table to a specified size.

methods.name: dictAdd
methods.description: Adds a new element to the hash table.

methods.name: dictReplace
methods.description: Replaces the value for an existing key or adds a new key-value pair.

methods.name: dictDelete
methods.description: Removes an element by key from the hash table.

methods.name: _dictClear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the hash table.

methods.name: dictRelease
methods.description: Releases the entire hash table and its resources.

methods.name: dictInitIterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the hash table.

methods.name: dictNext
methods.description: Returns the next element in the hash table during iteration.

methods.name: _dictExpandIfNeeded
methods.description: Expands the hash table if needed based on load.

methods.name: _dictNextPower
methods.description: Calculates the next power of two greater than or equal to a given size.

methods.name: _dictKeyIndex
methods.description: Finds the index for a new key or returns -1 if key exists.
